description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
The Badger enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Kodama.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Memnite from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
